learning_outcomes.text: Know the composition and elements that form an automobile.
Understand the physical phenomena that govern the operation of the different systems that make up a vehicle.
Understanding and interpretation of texts and data, development of skills for their concretization and clear and succinct presentation.
Aptitude for the distribution of resources and times and their implementation in real situations.
Ability to transmit concepts, ideas, processes, etc., related to Industrial Engineering orally and in writing, clearly and correctly.
Ability to use scientific-technical tools for solving calculation and design problems in Industrial Engineering and aptitude for finding sustainable engineering solutions.
Ability for teamwork and ability to develop multidisciplinary projects.

syllabus_topics: Components of the automobile vehicle: Longitudinal, lateral and vertical dynamics.
teaching_methods: Lectures: basic fundamentals, calculation theories, and theoretical formulation are explained.
Personal work: individual or small group work, to be defended in class.
Practical work: reports corresponding to each practical exercise will be collected.

assessment_methods.method: Tutorials and active participation in class

assessment_rules: To average the grades of the assessable tests and pass the course, a minimum grade of 5 (out of 10) must be obtained in each of them.
